reasoning_content: Now let's wait for this. The previous successful 3-way concurrent run (the first `just up`) had app ready at 3 min 21 sec, cms at 3 min 18 sec. So it should complete in about 4–6 minutes. I'll poll at 45-second intervals and monitor the memory.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  up=0
  for p in 39001 39002 39003; do
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$code" = "200" ] && up=$((up+1))
  done
  echo "check $i: $up/3  avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  [ $up -eq 3 ] && break
  sleep 45
done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  up=0
  for p in 39001 39002 39003; do
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$code" = "200" ] && up=$((up+1))
  done
  echo "check $i: $up/3  avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  [ $up -eq 3 ] && break
  sleep 45
done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Wait for all three dev servers final attempt"}
